text: Permanence, perseverance and persistence in spite of all obstacles, discouragements, and impossibilities: It is this, that in all things distinguishes the strong soul from the weak.
author: Thomas Carlyle

text: Obstacles don't have to stop you. If you run into a wall, don't turn around and give up. Figure out how to climb it, go through it, or work around it.
author: Michael Jordan

text: A hero is an ordinary individual who finds the strength to persevere and endure in spite of overwhelming obstacles.
author: Christopher Reeve

text: Stand up to your obstacles and do something about them. You will find that they haven't half the strength you think they have.
author: Norman Vincent Peale

text: One who gains strength by overcoming obstacles possesses the only strength which can overcome adversity.
author: Albert Schweitzer

text: There are plenty of difficult obstacles in your path. Don't allow yourself to become one of them.
author: Ralph Marston

text: When there's a setback, some people throw in the towel, others pull out all the stops.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: Obstacles are those frightful things you see when you take your eyes off your goal.
author: Henry Ford

text: The greater the obstacle, the more glory in overcoming it.
author: Moliere

text: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
author: Roger Crawford

text: Only those who dare to fail greatly can ever achieve greatly.
author: Robert F. Kennedy

text: Our very survival depends on our ability to stay awake, to adjust to new ideas, to remain vigilant and to face the challenge of change.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: It's not that I'm so smart, it's just that I stay with problems longer.
author: Albert Einstein

text: When you have a problem, concentrate on the solution — not the problem itself.
author: Thomas D. Willhite

text: Don't be distracted by criticism. Remember — the only taste of success some people have is when they take a bite out of you.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: When obstacles arise, you change your direction to reach your goal; you do not change your decision to get there.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: Everything is either an opportunity to grow or an obstacle to keep you from growing. You get to choose.
author: Wayne Dyer

text: If you find a path with no obstacles, it probably doesn't lead anywhere.
author: Frank A. Clark

text: Obstacles can't stop you. Problems can't stop you. Most of all, other people can't stop you. Only you can stop you.
author: Jeffrey Gitomer

text: All the world is full of suffering. It is also full of overcoming.
author: Helen Keller

text: Faith sees the opportunity; doubt sees the obstacles.
author: James MacDonald

text: Do not let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
author: John Wooden

text: Believe in yourself and all that you are. Know that there is something inside you that is greater than any obstacle.
author: Christian D. Larson

text: Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which one has had to overcome.
author: Booker T. Washington

text: Press on. Obstacles are seldom the same size tomorrow as they are today.
author: Robert H. Schuller

text: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
author: Confucius

text: Fear is an obstacle for some people, but it is an illusion to me. Failure always made me try harder next time.
author: Michael Jordan

text: If at first you don't succeed, try hard work.
author: William Feather

text: Obstacles will look large or small to you according to whether you are large or small.
author: Orison Swett Marden

text: The majority see the obstacles; the few see the objectives; history records the successes of the latter, while oblivion is the reward of the former.
author: Alfred Armand Montapert

text: There are many challenges, there are many obstacles; let us try to change the obstacles to advantages.
author: Harri Holkeri

text: You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
author: A.A. Milne

text: Rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
author: J.K. Rowling

text: You may have to fight a battle more than once to win it.
author: Margaret Thatcher

text: Strength doesn't come from what you can do. It comes from overcoming the things you once thought you couldn't.
author: Rikki Rogers

text: The human capacity for burden is like bamboo — far more flexible than you'd ever believe at first glance.
author: Jodi Picoult

text: You never know how strong you are until being strong is your only choice.
author: Bob Marley

text: Sometimes when you're in a dark place you think you've been buried, but actually you've been planted.
author: Christine Caine

text: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
author: Rumi

text: I can be changed by what happens to me. But I refuse to be reduced by it.
author: Maya Angelou

text: You are not a victim. No matter what you have been through, you're still here. You may have been challenged, hurt, betrayed, beaten, and discouraged, but nothing has defeated you. You are still here.
author: Steve Maraboli

text: The struggle you're in today is developing the strength you need for tomorrow.
author: Robert Tew

text: Hard times don't create heroes. It is during the hard times when the hero within us is revealed.
author: Bob Riley

text: What defines us is how well we rise after falling.
author: Unknown

text: Sometimes the bad things that happen in our lives put us directly on the path to the best things that will ever happen to us.
author: Nicole Reed

text: You were given this life because you are strong enough to live it.
author: Ain Eineziz

text: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford

text: The oak fought the wind and was broken, the willow bent when it must and survived.
author: Robert Jordan

text: You are confined only by the walls you build yourself.
author: Andrew Murphy

text: A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

text: Every adversity, every failure, every heartache carries with it the seed of an equal or greater benefit.
author: Napoleon Hill

text: Stars can't shine without darkness.
author: Unknown

text: It's not the load that breaks you down, it's the way you carry it.
author: Lou Holtz

text: Your current situation is not your final destination. The best is yet to come.
author: Unknown

text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese Proverb

text: The moment you're ready to quit is usually the moment right before the miracle happens. Don't give up.
author: Unknown

text: You have been assigned this mountain to show others it can be moved.
author: Mel Robbins

text: A ship in harbor is safe, but that's not what ships are built for.
author: John A. Shedd

text: If they can make penicillin out of moldy bread, they can make something out of you.
author: Muhammad Ali

text: The master has failed more times than the beginner has even tried.
author: Stephen McCranie

text: You survived things you thought would kill you. Don't forget that.
author: Unknown

text: You didn't come this far to fall apart now.
author: Unknown

text: Everyone you admire was once where you are now. They kept going. So can you.
author: Unknown

text: The fact that you're still trying means you haven't lost.
author: Unknown

text: What broke you is not allowed to define you.
author: Unknown

text: You have been through enough to know that hard doesn't mean impossible.
author: Unknown

text: She was a single mother on welfare, clinically depressed, rejected by 12 publishers. Then Harry Potter changed the world. Never count yourself out.
author: J.K. Rowling's story

text: He spent 27 years in a prison cell. He walked out and led a nation. Your setback is not your sentence.
author: Nelson Mandela's story

text: She was fired from her first TV job and told she was unfit for television. She became the most powerful woman in media. Don't let one person's opinion write your ending.
author: Oprah Winfrey's story

text: He was homeless, sleeping in his car, writing scripts nobody wanted. He sold his dog to survive. Then Rocky won Best Picture. Hold on a little longer.
author: Sylvester Stallone's story

text: He grew up in the projects, shot at age 12, with every reason to give up. He built an empire. Your environment is not your destiny.
author: Jay-Z's story

text: She lost her arm to a shark at 13. She got back on the surfboard. Whatever you've lost, you are still capable of more than you think.
author: Bethany Hamilton's story

text: He was fired from the very company he built. He came back and made it the most valuable company on earth. Getting knocked down is not the end of your story.
author: Steve Jobs' story

text: She was born to former slaves, orphaned at 7, and widowed young. She became the first self-made female millionaire in America. Your starting point is not your limit.
author: Madam C.J. Walker's story

text: He grew up homeless, sleeping in shelters between rap battles, with a world that said he'd never make it. Then he became one of the greatest of all time. They were wrong about you too.
author: Eminem's story

text: She was shot in the head for daring to go to school. She survived, and at 16 stood before the United Nations and kept speaking. If she didn't stop, neither can you.
author: Malala Yousafzai's story

text: I've been through things that would've broken most people. I am not most people.
author: Unknown

text: He was cut from his high school basketball team. He went home and cried. Then he became the greatest to ever play the game. Rejection is not the final word.
author: Michael Jordan's story

text: He failed in business twice, had a nervous breakdown, and lost eight elections before becoming President of the United States. Abraham Lincoln did not quit. Neither should you.
author: Abraham Lincoln's story

text: He was fired from a newspaper for lacking imagination. His first animation studio went bankrupt. He was told Mickey Mouse would never work. Walt Disney kept going anyway.
author: Walt Disney's story

text: He pitched his fried chicken recipe to over 1,000 restaurants before one said yes. He was 65 years old. Colonel Sanders proved it is never too late to begin again.
author: Colonel Sanders' story

text: He was sleeping in public bathrooms with his young son, broke and homeless. He became a millionaire and his story became a movie. Chris Gardner refused to let his son see him give up.
author: Chris Gardner's story

text: His shows flopped for six straight years. He was living in his car. Then Madea changed everything. Tyler Perry never stopped showing up.
author: Tyler Perry's story

text: She had polio as a child and nearly died in a bus accident that shattered her spine. She painted from her bed, in constant pain, and became one of the most celebrated artists in history. Frida Kahlo turned suffering into art.
author: Frida Kahlo's story

text: He couldn't speak until age 4. Teachers called him mentally slow. He was rejected from university. Albert Einstein changed our understanding of the universe. Don't let anyone put a ceiling on you.
author: Albert Einstein's story

text: Stephen King threw Carrie in the trash. His wife pulled it out and told him to keep going. It went on to sell 350 million copies. Someone in your life believes in you. Believe in yourself too.
author: Stephen King's story

text: Born without arms or legs, he attempted suicide at 10 years old. He went on to speak in front of millions around the world. Nick Vujicic is living proof that your limitation is not your life.
author: Nick Vujicic's story

text: She grew up in poverty, passed between orphanages, with no family and no future anyone could see. She taught herself to sew and built one of the most iconic fashion empires in history. Coco Chanel didn't come from money — she came from will.
author: Coco Chanel's story

text: He had a stutter so severe he could barely say his own name. He was told broadcasting was not for him. James Earl Jones became one of the most recognizable voices on earth. The thing they said would stop you might be the thing that sets you apart.
author: James Earl Jones' story

text: She was told women didn't belong in science. Universities refused to enroll her. She moved countries, worked in freezing labs with almost nothing, and became the first person ever to win two Nobel Prizes in two different sciences. Marie Curie didn't wait for permission to be brilliant.
author: Marie Curie's story

text: She survived years of abuse, was dropped by record labels, and had every reason to stop. Tina Turner walked away from everything at 44 with nothing but her name — and rebuilt herself into a legend. It is never too late to start over as yourself.
author: Tina Turner's story

text: She was born profoundly deaf. Teachers said music wasn't possible for her. Evelyn Glennie learned to feel sound through her body and became one of the world's most celebrated solo percussionists. She didn't overcome her limitation — she redefined what was possible within it.
author: Evelyn Glennie's story

text: He was diagnosed with ADHD as a child and told to lower his expectations. Michael Phelps channeled every ounce of that restless energy into the water and won 23 Olympic gold medals. Don't let anyone diagnose your ceiling.
author: Michael Phelps' story

text: A lesson without pain is meaningless... But by enduring that pain... he shall obtain a powerful, unmatched heart.
author: Edward Elric

text: Only those who have suffered long can see the light within the shadows.
author: Roronoa Zoro

text: No one is stronger than a man who healed his own wounds.
author: Toji Fushiguro

text: Being 'weak' means you have the potential to grow.
author: Ittetsu Takeda

text: Is it possible that what I needed wasn't the strength not to fear, but the resolve to take on the burden of that fear?
author: Yamada Asaemon Sagiri

text: You cannot alter your fate. However, you can rise to meet it.
author: Hi-Sama

text: The past can hurt... you can either run from it, or learn from it.
author: Rafiki

text: Our fate lives within us. You only have to be brave enough to see it.
author: Merida

text: The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.
author: The Emperor

text: You've survived every hard day so far.
author: Unknown

text: Obstacles are not stop signs.
author: Unknown

text: Hard times build strong souls.
author: Unknown

text: Your struggle is shaping your story.
author: Unknown

text: Pressure makes diamonds.
author: Unknown

text: You are tougher than this moment.
author: Unknown

text: What blocks you can build you.
author: Unknown

text: Keep going. The wall will break.
author: Unknown

text: Storms don't last. You do.
author: Unknown

text: Pain is proof you're still growing.
author: Unknown

text: If you are constantly in a storm, don't check the weather, check your decisions.
author: Unknown

text: When you focus on problems, you'll have more problems. When you focus on possibilities, you'll have more opportunities.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: You were made for tough seasons.
author: Unknown

text: Every setback is a setup.
author: Unknown

text: The fire refined you. It didn't ruin you.
author: Unknown

text: You bend, but you don't break.
author: Unknown

text: Difficult roads lead to beautiful places.
author: Unknown

text: Rise every time you fall.
author: Unknown

text: You are stronger than your excuses.
author: Unknown

text: The comeback is always stronger.
author: Unknown

text: Your story isn't over yet.
author: Unknown

text: Broken crayons still color.
author: Unknown

text: You are proof that hard doesn't mean impossible.
author: Unknown

text: What hurts you trains you.
author: Unknown

text: Struggle today. Strength tomorrow.
author: Unknown

text: You didn't quit. That's everything.
author: Unknown

text: Rock bottom builds rock-solid people.
author: Unknown

text: Every scar has a lesson.
author: Unknown

text: You're not stuck. You're growing.
author: Unknown

text: Champions are built in the dark.
author: Unknown

text: Tough times don't last. Tough people do.
author: Unknown

text: Your pain is building your power.
author: Unknown

text: The past shouldn't be feared for it guides our future.
author: Rafiki

text: The nicest thing about the rain is that it always stops. Eventually.
author: Eeyore

text: I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer. Fear is the little-death that brings total obliteration. I will face my fear.
author: Frank Herbert

text: If you sink to the bottom, don't come back up without the pearl.
author: Unknown

text: Do not fear the valley. That is where rivers learn to move.
author: Unknown

text: Some flowers only open after the rain has made a home of them.
author: Unknown

text: Even broken branches remember how to reach for the sun.
author: Unknown

text: Veni, vidi, vici — I came, I saw, I conquered.
author: Julius Caesar

text: Don't let life kill you before death does.
author: Unknown

text: Every time you see me, I will be better than the last time you saw me.
author: Unknown

text: Courage isn't having the strength to go on. It is going on when you don't have the strength.
author: Unknown

text: What good are wings without the courage to fly?
author: Unknown

text: You cannot learn to swim by reading a book. You have to get into the water.
author: Shiv Khera

text: No one can hold you back more than the parts of yourself.
author: Unknown

text: It may take everything, but it will change everything.
author: Unknown

text: She is the type of flower that can still grow after a forest fire.
author: Unknown
